attachments.origin_landmark: long head: infraglenoid tubercle; lateral head: posterior humerus, proximal to spiral groove (humerus_l); medial head: posterior humerus, distal to spiral groove (humerus_l)

actions: extends and adducts shoulder (long head only)

functional_compartments.name: Long head
functional_compartments.innervation_branch: radial n., branch to long head (proximal)

neuromuscular_junction_zone.location_description: mid-belly endplate band -- for where this band lies along the muscle, see motor_endplate_zones

functional_compartments.function_note: Only head crossing the shoulder; contributes to shoulder extension/adduction as well as elbow extension.
functional_compartments.source: Holzbaur KR, Murray WM, Delp SL (2005) Ann Biomed Eng 33(6):829-840 -- upper-extremity musculoskeletal model; Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell)

motor_endplate_zones.notes: Distal of two zones (Yi et al. 2023). This line runs DISTAL to PROXIMAL, so a higher percentage is nearer the shoulder.
motor_endplate_zones.source: Diaconu S et al. (Elias University Hospital), 'A Visual Guide to Ultrasound-Guided Botulinum Toxin Injection in Spasticity: Part II -- Proximal Upper Limb Muscles', Toxins 17(6):276 (2025), doi:10.3390/toxins17060276 -- review synthesis of the intramuscular neural arborization literature it cites (Yi, Li, Yang, Moon and others)

motor_endplate_zones.notes: Proximal of two zones. The clinic injects the long head at two sites accordingly -- mid posterior arm and 2 cm proximal to it. This line runs DISTAL to PROXIMAL, so a higher percentage is nearer the shoulder.
motor_endplate_zones.source: Diaconu S et al. (Elias University Hospital), 'A Visual Guide to Ultrasound-Guided Botulinum Toxin Injection in Spasticity: Part II -- Proximal Upper Limb Muscles', Toxins 17(6):276 (2025), doi:10.3390/toxins17060276 -- review synthesis of the intramuscular neural arborization literature it cites (Yi, Li, Yang, Moon and others)

functional_compartments.name: Lateral head
functional_compartments.innervation_branch: radial n., branch to lateral head (proximal, above spiral groove)

neuromuscular_junction_zone.location_description: mid-belly endplate band -- for where this band lies along the muscle, see motor_endplate_zones

functional_compartments.function_note: Superficial, strongest elbow-extension moment arm of the three heads.
functional_compartments.source: Holzbaur KR, Murray WM, Delp SL (2005) Ann Biomed Eng 33(6):829-840 -- upper-extremity musculoskeletal model; Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell)

motor_endplate_zones.notes: Single zone, the narrowest of the three heads. This line runs DISTAL to PROXIMAL, so a higher percentage is nearer the shoulder.
motor_endplate_zones.source: Diaconu S et al. (Elias University Hospital), 'A Visual Guide to Ultrasound-Guided Botulinum Toxin Injection in Spasticity: Part II -- Proximal Upper Limb Muscles', Toxins 17(6):276 (2025), doi:10.3390/toxins17060276 -- review synthesis of the intramuscular neural arborization literature it cites (Yi, Li, Yang, Moon and others)

functional_compartments.name: Medial head, superficial subregion
functional_compartments.innervation_branch: radial n., branch to medial head (distal, below spiral groove)

neuromuscular_junction_zone.location_description: along the central tendinous raphe -- for where this band lies along the muscle, see motor_endplate_zones

functional_compartments.function_note: Deep to long/lateral heads; active across the full range of elbow extension including low-force postural tasks (documented 'workhorse' recruitment pattern).
functional_compartments.source: Holzbaur KR, Murray WM, Delp SL (2005) Ann Biomed Eng 33(6):829-840 -- upper-extremity musculoskeletal model; Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); architecture note consistent with described deep/superficial subdivision of the medial head in cadaveric dissection studies

motor_endplate_zones.notes: Reported for the medial head as a whole; the source does not separate its superficial and deep parts, so the same zone is recorded on each. This line runs DISTAL to PROXIMAL, so a higher percentage is nearer the shoulder.
motor_endplate_zones.source: Diaconu S et al. (Elias University Hospital), 'A Visual Guide to Ultrasound-Guided Botulinum Toxin Injection in Spasticity: Part II -- Proximal Upper Limb Muscles', Toxins 17(6):276 (2025), doi:10.3390/toxins17060276 -- review synthesis of the intramuscular neural arborization literature it cites (Yi, Li, Yang, Moon and others)

functional_compartments.name: Medial head, deep subregion (adjacent to elbow joint capsule)
functional_compartments.innervation_branch: radial n., distal terminal twigs to medial head (continues as ulnar collateral/articular branch)

neuromuscular_junction_zone.location_description: along the central tendinous raphe -- for where this band lies along the muscle, see motor_endplate_zones

functional_compartments.function_note: Fibers blending into the posterior elbow joint capsule (articularis cubiti-like function), tensing the capsule during extension to prevent impingement.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell) (describes deepest medial-head fibers inserting into the posterior joint capsule)

motor_endplate_zones.notes: Reported for the medial head as a whole; the source does not separate its superficial and deep parts, so the same zone is recorded on each. This line runs DISTAL to PROXIMAL, so a higher percentage is nearer the shoulder.
motor_endplate_zones.source: Diaconu S et al. (Elias University Hospital), 'A Visual Guide to Ultrasound-Guided Botulinum Toxin Injection in Spasticity: Part II -- Proximal Upper Limb Muscles', Toxins 17(6):276 (2025), doi:10.3390/toxins17060276 -- review synthesis of the intramuscular neural arborization literature it cites (Yi, Li, Yang, Moon and others)

source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998); Holzbaur KR, Murray WM, Delp SL (2005) Ann Biomed Eng 33(6):829-840 -- upper-extremity musculoskeletal model

ultrasound_injection_approach.transducer_placement: Transverse at the midpoint of the posterior arm. Injection sites follow the heads: long head at mid-arm and again 2 cm proximal, lateral head at mid-arm, medial head 1 cm distal to mid-arm.
ultrasound_injection_approach.depth_layer: Superficial and medial to the humeral cortex.
ultrasound_injection_approach.notes: Second only to the posterior deltoid among muscles injected for the extended shoulder. In biceps-triceps co-contraction, injecting triceps reduces resistance to passive elbow flexion.
ultrasound_injection_approach.source: Diaconu S et al. (Elias University Hospital), 'A Visual Guide to Ultrasound-Guided Botulinum Toxin Injection in Spasticity: Part II -- Proximal Upper Limb Muscles', Toxins 17(6):276 (2025), doi:10.3390/toxins17060276 -- review synthesis of the intramuscular neural arborization literature it cites (Yi, Li, Yang, Moon and others)
